name: Vampire or ......?
source:
One fateful day, Aki, otherwise a regular uni student, meets the last surviving member of a clan of vampires. Later, she also encounters an exorcist who's after the vampire. Which one of them will fall for her and protect her from the other...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/11919]Freem![/url]]
translation:
在一个命运攸关的一天，原本是一名普通大学生的阿基遇到了吸血鬼部落的最后一位幸存成员。后来，她还遇到了一名追捕吸血鬼的驱魔师。他们中的哪一位会爱上她并保护她免受另一位的伤害……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/11919]Freem![/url]]
